gbm_population_evidence.quote: Histologically proven diagnosis of IDH-wildtype GBM (WHO grade 4) according to the 2021 WHO classification (including subtypes such as gliosarcoma).

candidate_evidence.quote: Neoadjuvant Chemoradiotherapy With or Without Concurrent Azeliragon in Patients With Newly Diagnosed Glioblastoma

The purpose of this window-of-opportunity study is to validate that the combination of azeliragon with RT and TMZ would modulate immune-suppressive myeloid and T cells in the tumor microenvironment in patients with GBM.

coder_notes: EARLY_PHASE1 (translational subset). Azeliragon is given in both arms: in the ACTIVE_COMPARATOR Arm 1 only in the adjuvant phase, in the experimental Arm 2 also concurrently with neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy; the trial question is the addition of concurrent azeliragon, so coded experimental_monotherapy with both arms listed. Target engagement: primary outcomes are immune-suppressive myeloid and T cells in post-chemoradiotherapy tumour tissue (surgery/LITT sampling), linked to azeliragon's stated mechanism. IDH-wildtype is a diagnostic entry criterion only.
